req_desc: The app presents one portfolio console whose public content is written by a signed-in owner.
The app keeps an unpublished work entry out of every public read ...
The app offers no public sign-up form ...
A visitor steers the console between five destinations with no session ...
An editor signs in, then reads every work entry, drafts among them ...
An owner publishes a work entry ...
An owner invites an editor by address ...
The app rejects a direct API call from an editor session to an owner-only endpoint at the server ...
Exactly one account holds the owner role.
The app seeds the account `owner@example.com` with the owner role ...
The app answers `GET /api/console` with the profile, the published work, the published studies, the published recognitions, the cities ...
The app keeps one drawing surface in place across every destination change.
The app fills the home destination with a point-built portrait, a drifting letter field, a biography panel, three callout annotations ...
The app scrolls no public destination at any window size ...
The app draws the navigation diagram in the upper right as the only navigation the public console has ...
The app maintains a parallel structure carrying every string the scene draws, in reading order ...
The app exposes the wordmark `MARLOW HENDRIKS` on every destination ...
The app answers `POST /api/auth/login` with an `access_token` for a correct address with a correct password ...
The app answers a wrong password with the pinned sign-in failure sentence ...
The app locks an account for `15` minutes after `5` consecutive failed sign-ins ...
The app sends a signed-out request for a studio route to the sign-in route carrying the intended path ...
The app bounds a work entry title at `1` to `120` characters after trimming ...
The app refuses a missing title inline with `Give the entry a title.` ...
The app disables no submit control anywhere ...
The app clears no form on a failure of any kind.
The app carries the version a work entry write was made from ...
The app writes a new work entry unpublished at the position at the end of the shelf ...
The app answers a publish with the pinned publish banner sentence ...
The app omits an unpublished work entry from the console read ...
The app writes a work entry preview image to the bucket under the key scheme `previews/{entry_id}/{sha256_of_bytes}.png` ...
The app serves a published entry preview image to a visitor with no session ...
The app regenerates the preview image when the grid seed changes ...
The app holds the work order beside the study order on one shelf page ...
The app moves a shelf row by pointer drag from a six-dot handle at the row left ...
The app writes every affected shelf position in one transaction ...
The app keeps shelf positions dense from zero, unique across every entry ...
The app re-settles every visible two-digit position label when an order is committed.
The app bounds a message sender name at `1` to `80` characters after trimming ...
The app answers a sent message with the pinned sent banner sentence ...
The app refuses a contact submission whose decoy field is filled ...
The app stores a message with the sender name, the sender address, the body, the state, the source route, the arrival moment ...
The app renders a message body as text everywhere the body appears ...
The app marks an open message read after `1` second on screen ...
The app renders an unknown address as `404 NOT FOUND` on the failure route ...
The app matches a failure code against its closed table before rendering ...
The app renders an editor reaching an owner-only surface as `403 NOT PERMITTED` ...
The app records a public destination view with the route, with the moment ...
The app shows a loading counter reading three digits with a percent sign before a first scene ...
The app hands over from the loading surface to the scene by a fade ...
The app holds a placeholder on screen at least `500` milliseconds.
The app speaks only the sentences the brief pins, inventing none ...
The app serves the home destination at `/` to a visitor with no session ...
The app lands a signed-in visitor asking for sign-in on the dashboard ...
The app shows a loading state on every list ...
The app grounds every destination in a near-black neutral ...
The app sets every string in the declared technical sans family stack ...
The app eases every entrance, every exit, looping nothing ...
The app meets the WCAG AA contrast bar on body text against its ground ...
The app keeps one arrangement between any two wide sizes, changing the size alone ...
The app serves a single-page application against a JSON API on one origin ...
The app introduces no second database, no cache, no queue, no second object store, no identity provider, no mail vendor ...
The app holds one drawing surface at the full window size across every destination change ...
The app composites at least three post-processing passes over the rendered scene ...
The app loads the studio surface separately from the console surface.
The app degrades one tier at a time when the frame rate falls ...
The app carries a strict transport policy on every response ...
The app declares a distinct title on every public destination ...
The app exposes no credential, no access key, no session token in anything the browser downloads.
The app downloads no image file, no audio file, no scene binary, no font file from its own origin.
The app keeps an accounts table carrying a unique lowercased address.
The app keeps a sessions table storing a token hash rather than the cookie value.
The app keeps exactly one profile row.
The app keeps a work entries table carrying a position, a published flag, a preview key, a version.
The app keeps an entry links table bounded at four rows per entry.
The app keeps a studies table carrying a field seed with a position.
The app keeps a recognitions table naming exactly one city per row.
The app keeps a cities table carrying a coordinate pair.
The app keeps a messages table carrying a state with a source route.
The app keeps a page views table carrying a route with a moment, nothing else.
The app stores every timestamp in UTC.
The app accepts exactly one of two writes to one entry made from the same version ...
The app seeds the study `Ridge Survey` published at the first position ...
The app duplicates no row when the app restarts.
The app writes the seeded credentials into `/app/USER_README.md`.
The app sets annotation bodies at `11px` on a line box of `13.2px` ...
The app sets a navigation plate label at ten scene units.
The app draws seven symbols, no eighth, each on a whole-unit grid.
The app rounds no corner but the circular inbox state dot ...
The app carries depth by overlap with strength rather than by a drop shadow.
The app presents base geometry at once, the destination marker next, the annotations last.
The app draws the compass over the terrain when the work destination has anything published.
The app fills a shelf row under the pointer, darkening the fill under a drag ...
The app serves one portfolio for one owner, with no second profile.
The app offers no recognition editor ...
The app calls no external service to satisfy a request at run time.
The app stays responsive at `200` work entries with `5000` messages, `50000` page views.
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
The app serves the HTTP API on the same origin under the `/api` prefix.
The app answers `GET /api/health` with `200` once ready.
The app starts from the environment image with no manual step.
The app writes login credentials to `/app/USER_README.md`.
The app creates an empty `.browser_screenshots/` directory at the app root ...
The app serves a production build behind a static server, never a dev server.
The app keeps its server running after the session ends, never as a child of the shell.
The app binds `0.0.0.0`, never `127.0.0.1`.
The app uses no persistent volume, no fixed container name, no custom network.
The app answers an invalid request as a client error, never as a server failure ...
